content: Govern and implement the replacement of the static Codex, Claude Code, and ZCode commit-identity table with automatic runtime harness-subject discovery and deterministic identity derivation, while preserving human Git configuration and all historical commit evidence.

Activated D0028/SC0004: the runtime harness subject replaces the static Codex, Claude Code, and ZCode mapping table as the authority for both Git Author and Committer; missing or ambiguous evidence fails without falling back to human Git configuration.

Published transient D0028 migration guidance G004 to S0100-20260828-013-m0100-foundation and G007 to S0100-20260830-001-m0100-completion-sprint; each target owner will disposition and remove its packet at the next control boundary.

Removed the static Codex, Claude Code, and ZCode mapping table and the fixed --harness selector. Seven of seven isolated cases passed, including an unseen future-agent subject, nearest-ancestor selection, a direct declaration path isolated from /proc, Git identity isolation, and protected commit options; the live runtime automatically resolved Agent Harness (codex) <codex@localhost>.

Committed the coherent D0028 migration as e5d996bacb0527a0007749cf5409cbc42b1158ab without a fixed harness selector or manually supplied identity. Git recorded Agent Harness (codex) <codex@localhost> as both Author and Committer while repository-local human configuration remained amamiya <amamiya@localhost>.

Committed 0aac137a229300ce0f5317f78a244e610caeaaac to clarify that the then-current direct declaration bypassed process metadata; independent review passed the seven-case suite and exact direct/fallback call-count probes.

The user corrected D0028 before SC0004 application: no /proc, ancestor, or product-environment inference is permitted. The active agent must first read and surface its own harness subject, then provide that generic command-local declaration to the helper for validation and deterministic Git identity derivation.

Published G005 and G008 as self-declaration successors to the immutable ready packets G004 and G007. The target owners will follow the explicit supersedes relationship, disposition the current direction, and remove both generations at their next guidance control boundary.

After emitting Agent harness subject: codex from the active AI/harness context, supplied command-local METAFLUX_AGENT_HARNESS=codex and committed corrected content revision 4c23b3f596badcb1c341780a93050917bd994c88. Git recorded Agent Harness (codex) <codex@localhost> as both roles while local human configuration remained amamiya <amamiya@localhost>.

Independent review found two precision gaps after 4c23b3f: the architecture text said detected/normalized although the helper only validates a self-declared normalized subject, and the source-level no-proc assertion matched only one literal style. Revision 0101a4a549436e6dd8f4c94175685811d37c90d0 corrected both through the same self-declared codex commit path.

Applied SC0004 to revision 0101a4a549436e6dd8f4c94175685811d37c90d0 after start-work 7/7, agent-record 163/163, semantic-change 21/21, routing 34/34, guidance 20/20, locked-evidence, residual, and diff gates passed. The D0028/SC0004 authority replacement is a dark roast; concurrent M0100 progress files remain excluded.
